Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick favor — small runway/top-up for POC

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well — the engineering team at HelioHealth is in the final validation stretch of the Redwood POC. We’ve uncovered one last integration scenario that’s blocking go/no-go testing and it looks like we’ll need a small extension on the trial to finish end-to-end tests.

Specifically: would Redwood consider a 30-day trial extension plus a one-time $2,000 platform credit to cover additional token usage while we complete validation? If we convert within 45 days, we’re prepared to sign the standard 6‑month commitment.

We’re on a tight timeline for the quarter and this unlock would materially improve the odds of a close. Appreciate any help you can provide or if you can point me to the right person for approvals.

Thanks —
Sasha Li
Senior Product Manager
HelioHealth

Ben/Marissa — forwarding Sasha’s ask. Quick summary: HelioHealth requests a 30‑day trial extension + $2,000 platform credit to finish POC. They’ve indicated willingness to sign a 6‑month commitment if converted within 45 days.

Proposal I’m recommending: grant a one‑time $1,500 credit + 30‑day extension, include a small onboarding credit for usage spikes, and require contract signature within 45 days for the conversion incentive to be honored. This reduces the net credit but keeps the ask compelling to the customer.

Attached is a one‑page request worksheet (credit-request-helio.xlsx) with usage projections. Quick approvals here would let me close before the quarter end.

Ask: approve the $1,500 credit + 30d extension with the 45‑day signature condition? If you’d prefer to keep the $2k ask, say so and I’ll escalate.

Priya
